description: Synthetic evaluation-only catalog, not real games or market data. Every game and company is explicitly named Fixture. These ten manually specified cases exercise inclusive maxPrice boundaries, review eligibility, deterministic name tie-breaking, ranking, literal title matching and no-result behavior. As in the existing API contract, maxPrice is inclusive and titleQuery is a case-insensitive literal substring. The free-price case intentionally expects the natural-language meaning even though the current rules parser does not recognize 'free'. This fixture does not expand or replace the product demo catalog.

games.name: Fixture Below Budget
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: one cent below a 20 dollar ceiling.

games.name: Fixture Exact Budget
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: exactly at a 20 dollar ceiling.

games.name: Fixture Freeport
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: one cent above a 20 dollar ceiling; a paid title containing free is not a free game.

games.name: Fixture Alpha Tie
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: equal price, alphabetically first.

games.name: Fixture Beta Tie
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: equal price, alphabetically second.

games.name: Fixture No Reviews
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: deliberately inconsistent maximum rating with zero reviews, to test eligibility.

games.name: Fixture Story Anchor
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: exactly at both the rating threshold and price ceiling.

games.name: Fixture Story Bronze
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: just below the 4.4 rating threshold despite many reviews.

games.name: Fixture Story Silver
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: high rating with a small positive review count.

games.name: Fixture 100%_Quest
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: percent and underscore are literal title characters.

games.name: Fixture 100XXQuest
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: a distractor that would match unescaped SQL wildcard characters.

games.name: Fixture Orbit
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: the shorter of two similar titles.

games.name: Fixture Orbit Echo
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: the longer title contains the complete shorter title.

games.name: Fixture Revenue Leader
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: highest revenue but not highest rating, reviews or ownership.

games.name: Fixture Owners Leader
games.summary: Synthetic boundary fixture: highest review count and ownership, second highest revenue.
